coverage_notes: Exercises nested state-directory creation, Unicode titles, and JSON readability.
Checks monotonic IDs, ascending list order, and statistics after mixed mutations.
Verifies malformed and repeated completion requests do not corrupt persisted state.
Confirms independent data-file paths remain isolated across process invocations.
Covers malformed JSON and deterministic filesystem failures without tracebacks.

tests.description: A Unicode todo round-trips through a newly created nested data directory and leaves readable JSON state.
tests.script:
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    state = pathlib.Path(td) / 'deep' / 'nested' / 'todos.json'
    title = 'Ship café ☕ / 東京'
    add = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'todo.py', '--data-file', str(state), 'add', title], text=True, capture_output=True)
    assert add.returncode == 0, (add.stdout, add.stderr)
    assert f'Added todo 1: {title}' in add.stdout
    assert state.is_file()
    raw = state.read_bytes()
    raw.decode('utf-8')
    json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'))
    listed = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'todo.py', '--data-file', str(state), 'list'], text=True, capture_output=True)
    assert listed.returncode == 0, (listed.stdout, listed.stderr)
    assert f'[ ] 1: {title}' in listed.stdout
    assert 'Traceback' not in listed.stderr
print('unicode roundtrip ok')

tests.description: Completing an item does not recycle its ID, and list --all remains ordered after a later add.
tests.script:
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

def run(state, *args):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'todo.py', '--data-file', str(state), *args], text=True, capture_output=True)

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    state = pathlib.Path(td) / 'state.json'
    for expected, title in [(1, 'alpha edge'), (2, 'beta edge')]:
        result = run(state, 'add', title)
        assert result.returncode == 0, (result.stdout, result.stderr)
        assert f'Added todo {expected}: {title}' in result.stdout
    completed = run(state, 'done', '1')
    assert completed.returncode == 0, (completed.stdout, completed.stderr)
    third = run(state, 'add', 'gamma edge')
    assert third.returncode == 0, (third.stdout, third.stderr)
    assert 'Added todo 3: gamma edge' in third.stdout
    shown = run(state, 'list', '--all')
    assert shown.returncode == 0, (shown.stdout, shown.stderr)
    lines = shown.stdout.splitlines()
    positions = [lines.index('[x] 1: alpha edge'), lines.index('[ ] 2: beta edge'), lines.index('[ ] 3: gamma edge')]
    assert positions == sorted(positions)
    stats = run(state, 'stats')
    assert stats.returncode == 0, (stats.stdout, stats.stderr)
    for line in ('Total: 3', 'Pending: 2', 'Completed: 1'):
        assert line in stats.stdout
print('monotonic ordering ok')

tests.description: Missing add arguments, malformed IDs, and repeated completion fail concisely without changing stored data.
tests.script:
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

def run(state, *args):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'todo.py', '--data-file', str(state), *args], text=True, capture_output=True)

def check_error(result):
    assert result.returncode == 2, (result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr)
    assert result.stderr.strip()
    assert 'Traceback' not in result.stderr

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    state = pathlib.Path(td) / 'state.json'
    missing = run(state, 'add')
    check_error(missing)
    assert not state.exists()

    added = run(state, 'add', 'immutable task')
    assert added.returncode == 0, (added.stdout, added.stderr)
    before_bad_id = state.read_bytes()
    malformed = run(state, 'done', 'not-an-integer')
    check_error(malformed)
    assert state.read_bytes() == before_bad_id

    first_done = run(state, 'done', '1')
    assert first_done.returncode == 0, (first_done.stdout, first_done.stderr)
    after_done = state.read_bytes()
    repeated = run(state, 'done', '1')
    check_error(repeated)
    assert state.read_bytes() == after_done
print('invalid mutations preserved state')

tests.description: Two explicitly selected data files maintain independent IDs, titles, and completion statistics.
tests.script:
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

def run(state, *args):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'todo.py', '--data-file', str(state), *args], text=True, capture_output=True)

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    root = pathlib.Path(td)
    left = root / 'left.json'
    right = root / 'right.json'
    a = run(left, 'add', 'left-only')
    b = run(right, 'add', 'right-only')
    assert a.returncode == b.returncode == 0, (a.stderr, b.stderr)
    assert 'Added todo 1: left-only' in a.stdout
    assert 'Added todo 1: right-only' in b.stdout
    done = run(left, 'done', '1')
    assert done.returncode == 0, (done.stdout, done.stderr)

    left_all = run(left, 'list', '--all')
    right_pending = run(right, 'list')
    assert '[x] 1: left-only' in left_all.stdout
    assert 'right-only' not in left_all.stdout
    assert '[ ] 1: right-only' in right_pending.stdout
    assert 'left-only' not in right_pending.stdout

    left_stats = run(left, 'stats')
    right_stats = run(right, 'stats')
    for line in ('Total: 1', 'Pending: 0', 'Completed: 1'):
        assert line in left_stats.stdout
    for line in ('Total: 1', 'Pending: 1', 'Completed: 0'):
        assert line in right_stats.stdout
print('store isolation ok')

tests.description: Malformed JSON and an unusable parent path produce helpful failures without Python tracebacks.
tests.script:
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

def run(state, *args):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'todo.py', '--data-file', str(state), *args], text=True, capture_output=True)

def assert_clean_failure(result):
    assert result.returncode != 0, (result.stdout, result.stderr)
    assert result.stderr.strip(), (result.stdout, result.stderr)
    assert 'Traceback' not in result.stderr

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    root = pathlib.Path(td)
    malformed = root / 'malformed.json'
    malformed.write_text('{ definitely not valid json', encoding='utf-8')
    bad_json = run(malformed, 'list')
    assert_clean_failure(bad_json)
    assert malformed.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == '{ definitely not valid json'

    blocker = root / 'not-a-directory'
    blocker.write_text('keep me', encoding='utf-8')
    impossible = blocker / 'todos.json'
    bad_path = run(impossible, 'add', 'cannot persist')
    assert_clean_failure(bad_path)
    assert blocker.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == 'keep me'
    assert not impossible.exists()
print('clean storage errors ok')
